headline: Intel will keep working on Elon Musk's Terafab chipmaking venture, according to Bloomberg News.
score_reason: Lowered from 7: headline only, so the detail is unverified.
importance_line: It bears on whether Terafab, Musk's planned chip plant for his own companies, keeps Intel as a manufacturing partner, but the terms are unknown.
summary: Bloomberg News reports, according to headlines also carried by Reuters, that Intel will keep working on Elon Musk's Terafab chipmaking venture. On 4 Oct we reported that Musk confirmed talks with TSMC about Terafab, with Intel the only other named partner.
notes: Reuters 401, Bloomberg and Investing.com texts not readable; only headlines seen via Google News (Reuters, Bloomberg, Investing.com, TradingView, which adds 'CEO says'). Headline only. Follows C08-01 of the 4 Oct edition (Terafab/TSMC, Tom's Hardware, 3 Oct).
